data.title: End of injury benefit (Verletztengeld) after workplace accident
data.summary: Beispiel-Berufsgenossenschaft Bau und Holz informs Ruben Beispielgaard that, following the occupational doctor's report of 5 December 2024, his injury benefit (Verletztengeld) from his workplace accident of 26 August 2024 ends with the close of 15 December 2024 since he is fit for work again from 16 December 2024. A final payment of €1,064.25 for the period 1–15 December 2024 will be transferred, and further outpatient treatment costs continue to be covered.
data.explanation: This is a decision (Bescheid) from the statutory accident insurance (gesetzliche Unfallversicherung) ending your injury benefit because the doctor found you fit for work again. You still receive a final payment for 1–15 December 2024, and outpatient treatment costs keep being covered. If you disagree with the decision — for example if you think you are not yet fit for work — you may file an objection (Widerspruch), in writing or on record at the office, by the deadline the app shows. If you do not object, the decision becomes final. No action is needed regarding the payment itself.

items.action: If you disagree with the decision to end your injury benefit, submit a written objection (Widerspruch) to Beispiel-Berufsgenossenschaft Bau und Holz, or have it recorded in person, by the deadline shown.
